description: Source code for GPIO driver for the Rohm BD8LB600FS device in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, initialization, and GPIO control functions.

methods.name: write_state
methods.description: Writes the specified GPIO state to the device via SPI.

methods.name: bd8lb600fs_pin_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin on the device with specified flags.

methods.name: bd8lb600fs_port_get_raw
methods.description: Retrieves raw input port data (not supported).

methods.name: bd8lb600fs_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO pins based on mask and value.

methods.name: bd8lb600fs_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, including SPI and GPIO reset pin.
